panels.title: Knock workflow triggers by outcome, over time
panels.description: huntloop_knock_triggers_total - every notification trigger routed through huntloop.knock_client (huntloop.feedback_alerts, huntloop.budget_alerts), split by outcome (success / not_configured / daily_budget_exhausted / monthly_budget_exhausted / trigger_error). No separate per-provider Resend panel exists in this project to mirror directly (nothing calls huntloop.resend_client itself anymore - Resend is now reached only via Knock, see CLAUDE.md) - this dashboard follows the layout/style of the existing huntloop-modal-resume dashboard instead.

panels.title: Successful triggers vs. failures (current)
panels.description: huntloop_knock_triggers_total summed across the whole history, grouped by outcome - a snapshot of how often notifications actually go through vs. being blocked/erroring, not a rate.

panels.title: Budget-cap rejections, over time
panels.description: huntloop_knock_triggers_total{outcome=~"daily_budget_exhausted|monthly_budget_exhausted"} - triggers that were blocked specifically because KNOCK_DAILY_TRIGGER_BUDGET or KNOCK_MONTHLY_TRIGGER_BUDGET was already spent, as opposed to Knock not being configured or erroring.

panels.title: Daily trigger budget used vs. cap
panels.description: huntloop_knock_daily_budget_used / huntloop_knock_daily_budget_cap - the knock_usage ledger's today's triggers_sent against KNOCK_DAILY_TRIGGER_BUDGET (default 100), updated on every budget check. Resets to 0 at the start of each UTC day.

panels.title: Monthly trigger budget used vs. cap
panels.description: huntloop_knock_monthly_budget_used / huntloop_knock_monthly_budget_cap - the knock_usage ledger's current-month triggers_sent against KNOCK_MONTHLY_TRIGGER_BUDGET (default 3000), updated on every budget check. Resets to 0 at the start of each calendar month.
